The anchor is seeded into the NSGA-II population (sss_core/nsga2.py:172-183), so max_f1_star >= anchor holds BY CONSTRUCTION; measured, 49 of 50 recorded units have max_f1_star EXACTLY equal to the anchor. zero_method='wilcox' discards those zeros, leaving <= 1 valid pair per variant against an n_guard of 5, so all five variants could only report 'insufficient'. primary_comparison.estimand: dq_all = max{ f_q(p) : p in front } - f_q(anchor point in that front)
primary_comparison.why_this_estimand: the anchor is the COVERAGE-maximal point, so any estimand conditioned on f1 >= anchor_f1 can only ever admit the anchor itself. Measured on the 49 v1 units with a locatable anchor: dq (quality at matched coverage) = 0/49 nonzero, dom (strict domination) = 0/49, mq (coverage at matched quality) = 0/49 -- all structurally tied. dq_all is the only candidate that relaxes coverage, which is the only direction the front actually moves: 20/49 nonzero, sd 0.940
primary_comparison.stratum_rule: a priori anchor-degeneracy, frozen BEFORE v2: a family is in the structural-null stratum if it is the all-STR degenerate-anchor family or its median distinct_fq < 2
primary_comparison.stratum_rule_outcome_on_v1_evidence: Applying the rule as written to the v1 synthetic families: M1NC and M3NC are the all-STR degenerate-anchor families (STRUCT-NULL by the first clause); M2WF has median distinct_fq 1.5 < 2 (STRUCT-NULL by the second clause); M2WH and M4WH have median 2.0 (PRIMARY). The primary stratum is therefore M2WH + M4WH, pooled n = 20 on v1 data. NOTE this differs from the ticket-22 working note, which had provisionally listed M2WF as primary on the grounds of its dq_all spread; the RULE is authoritative over that note, and the rule was frozen before v2 rather than tuned to keep a family in.
primary_comparison.primary_test: scipy.stats.ttest_1samp(dq_all_pooled, popmean=0.0, alternative='greater')  # one-sided, pooled over the primary stratum
primary_comparison.zeros: RETAINED. A zero dq_all is a true 'no quality headroom', not a missing value; no zero_method filtering anywhere in this test
primary_comparison.secondary: the same one-sided test per family, Holm-adjusted across the primary stratum, for locating only
primary_comparison.robustness_gate: a sign-flip permutation p (1e5 flips, numpy only) is reported alongside; if the t and permutation p disagree across alpha, the result is reported INCONCLUSIVE
primary_comparison.multiplicity: the primary test is a single pooled test and carries no correction; the per-family Holm is secondary
primary_comparison.known_power: Power is stated for the OPERATIVE stratum, which the stratum rule determines (see stratum_rule_outcome_on_v1_evidence: M2WH + M4WH, pooled n = 20, measured mean 0.81072, sd 0.88042 on v1 dq_all). At n=20 the MDE at 80% power, one-sided alpha 0.05, is 0.579*sd = 0.5099. At n=10 per family it is 0.86*sd. IMPORTANT: v1 measured that sd on the coverage-era artifacts and the estimand is defined for v2, so this does NOT certify the design -- v2 records the pooled test as primary and reports the achieved effect regardless of significance. The superseded ticket-22 note had provisionally pooled three families at n=30, sd 1.05854; those figures belong to that note, not to this freeze.

coverage_parity_as_result.statement: The greedy anchor is retained as an elite in the initial population under an elitist algorithm, so every front's coverage-maximal member equals the anchor's coverage: 49/50 exact ties in v1, the 50th +0.1. This is a STRUCTURAL consequence of the warm start, not an empirical finding. v2 makes no coverage-improvement claim and runs no significance test on the coverage axis
coverage_parity_as_result.paper_wording: Reported as a construction and a count, in the results, as a result. It is neither a failure of the search nor an omission.

convergence_criterion.subject: distinct_fq per unit per budget (NOT front_size)
convergence_criterion.plateau_rule: CONVERGED iff |median_i s_{i,b1} - median_i s_{i,b0}| <= 1.0 AND max_i |s_{i,b1} - s_{i,b0}| <= 2.0 (v1's rule, inherited unchanged)
convergence_criterion.median_definition: difference of medians across the top budget pair, NOT the median of per-seed deltas (v1 audit found these conflated; the two differ by ~50x)
convergence_criterion.unconverged_action: if any stratum is UNCONVERGED, v2 reports NOT-YET-CONVERGED for that stratum and makes NO physical claim about it. 'Front collapse' and 'phase transition' are forbidden declarations in every branch

promotion_convergence.why: v1's robustness_note asserted 'dead at all budgets, already established and expected to hold' -- a conclusion whose warrant was an empirical expectation rather than a proof, while the readout itself was never converged
promotion_convergence.ladder: the same budget ladder as the main matrix; escalation beyond 160/240 is a new decision because the allowance is consumed
promotion_convergence.plateau_criterion: CONVERGED(f) iff |median_i s_{i,b1} - median_i s_{i,b0}| <= 1.0 dB AND max_i |s_{i,b1} - s_{i,b0}| <= 2.0 dB, applied to promotion.spread_db over the top budget pair, per family

structural_dimension.quantity: R_fam = max over (task x feasible start x routed mode x registered PRF) of unenforced aasr_direct_db, minus the min; budget- and solver-independent
structural_dimension.domain_correction: the 6.0 dB threshold lives in the unenforced-AASR domain. The earlier formulation compared it against f_Q, which is m^-2 and cannot be compared to a dB threshold; v2 measures the structural bound in AASR dB
structural_dimension.v1_evidence: all nine registered families measured below 6.0 dB (M1NC/M3NC 0.037, M2WH 5.379, M2WF 5.464, M4WH 5.499, P6WH 5.439, P7WH 5.456, P8WH 5.501, P9WH 5.303) while the platform-level range is 71.03 dB: the platform can express the spread, the registered families cannot
structural_dimension.knife_edge_disclosure: P8WH sits 0.499 dB below the threshold and shares the aasr_direct model with the readout, which carries the registered D06-6 limitation (M=1 uniform aperture; Song's scan-dependent element pattern is not reproduced). 'Structurally dead' is a MODEL-level statement and is labelled as such; it is never stated as physics

two_dimensional_verdict.DEAD_CONVERGED: non-triggerable by structural bound (budget-independent) and the readout converged to a plateau below threshold
two_dimensional_verdict.DEAD_UNCONVERGED: non-triggerable by structural bound ONLY; the readout is NOT-YET-CONVERGED (still ascending toward R_fam). The deadness is stated as structural, explicitly not as a converged-readout result
two_dimensional_verdict.ALIVE_CONVERGED: the scenario admits spreads up to R_fam >= 6.0 dB; the plateau value is reported with a budget caveat, and promotion fires iff the plateau >= 6.0
two_dimensional_verdict.ALIVE_UNCONVERGED: NO CLAIM. The scenario admits >= 6.0 dB and the readout has not plateaued; report NOT-YET-CONVERGED and forbid any alive/dead assertion

serial_bound_derivation.definition: the maximum served-priority fraction attainable when tasks are placed one at a time in descending priority order, each starting no earlier than the previous task's padded dwell plus its C2 transfer requirement (min-over-pairs transfer, the legal lower bound -- an average or worst-case transfer is not a strict bound)
serial_bound_derivation.caliber: these are the SYNTHETIC M-family values, measured before the Eq.(22) switch; v2 recomputes them on the R families and registers the recomputed values in an amendment BEFORE the run
serial_bound_derivation.why_the_window_width_dominates: in every measured family the serial bound is set by how many tasks fit given the C2 gap, not by priority ordering -- the windows are narrow relative to the transfer requirement, which is why the bound falls as density rises

capacity_artifacts.closure_reading: closure = served_fraction / serial_bound. This is a CONTAINMENT reading (how close to the sequential limit the parallel schedule gets), NOT a validation score: at a single constant reference the level is near-tautological. The observation is the closure DEVIATION PATTERN vs the overload axis, and specifically where the transfer regime changes
capacity_artifacts.rule: until the v2 recomputation lands, no capacity NUMBER may appear in the paper; the v1 values above are registered here as the derivation and caliber, not as a v2 result

caliber_and_gates.synthetic_family_caliber: every artifact under experiments/results/ predates ticket 15's Eq.(22) switch and is caliber v1; any v2 consumption of those numbers must carry the caliber tag (ticket 15 item 21)
caliber_and_gates.domain_suite_in_gate: the v1 gate ran only the shared-library suite (verify.py shared_lib_tests); v2 requires the domain suite to be part of the gate chain, otherwise 'gate PASS' does not mean the artifacts are compliant (ticket 17 item)
domain_guards_required: AASRGrid axes span the mode envelope with preserved cell density
the mode-aware domain guard accepts the STR/SPT edge and refuses past the SLS edge
T_env_max equals the per-mode envelope maximum

forbidden: changing any frozen threshold after seeing results: promotion 6.0 dB, AASR -13 dB main, plateau 1.0/2.0 dB, solver pop/gen ladder, alpha 0.05
declaring front collapse or a phase transition in any branch, converged or not (already falsified)
any physical claim about a stratum whose convergence verdict is UNCONVERGED
re-running the frozen families in place; all v2 output goes to explicitly injected directories
treating the vector squint (realwindows) and squint_at as the same quantity: different scales AND different zero points (measured: vector minimum ~600 s from the planar zero)
per-seed cherry-picking: all seeds are reported per variant

predictions.note: A preregistration that cannot be wrong is the failure this file exists to prevent. Each prediction states the quantity, the threshold, and the observation that would refute it. Thresholds are NOT tuned to v1 evidence; they are the ones the spec already fixed.

P1_front_richness.quantity: median distinct_fq per density band, at the top budget of the registered ladder (160/240), in the real-window family
P1_front_richness.prediction: median distinct_fq >= 3 in EVERY density band, at sufficient budget
P1_front_richness.refutation: any band whose ladder has PLATEAUED (CONVERGED per convergence_criterion) and still shows median distinct_fq < 3
P1_front_richness.critical_caveat: if a band is UNCONVERGED the prediction is NOT-YET-TESTED for that band, not refuted. Reporting a refutation for an unconverged band is a forbidden move.
P1_front_richness.forbidden_if_refuted: no statement of 'front collapse' or 'phase transition' -- the prediction is about richness at sufficient budget, and its failure means the budget was insufficient or the front is genuinely narrow, neither of which licenses a phase-transition claim

P2_quality_headroom.quantity: dq_all pooled over the primary stratum (P-estimand, one-sided test above)
P2_quality_headroom.prediction: the search confers measurable quality headroom over the greedy anchor at matched front, i.e. mean dq_all > 0 with the pooled one-sided test rejecting at alpha 0.05
P2_quality_headroom.refutation: the pooled test fails to reject -- reported as a RESULT ('no measurable quality headroom'), never as a failure of the experiment
P2_quality_headroom.mandatory_wording: the coverage-parity statement travels with this result in every branch

P3_promotion.quantity: promotion two-dimensional verdict (structural R_fam x budget convergence)
P3_promotion.prediction: promotion does not fire in the registered real-window families
P3_promotion.refutation: any unit whose spread_db >= 6.0 dB, OR any family whose R_fam >= 6.0 dB (structural liveness)
P3_promotion.note: the v1 evidence supports non-firing but on the SYNTHETIC families; the real-window families have different geometry and the prediction is re-tested, not inherited

P4_capacity.quantity: closure = served_fraction / serial_bound, per overload band (the serial bound's derivation and v1 measurement are registered under capacity_artifacts)
P4_capacity.prediction: the closure DEVIATION PATTERN vs the overload axis is NOT flat: it changes regime where the transfer requirement begins to bind, i.e. where the C2 gap exceeds the window width and the serial bound starts falling with density
P4_capacity.refutation: the closure pattern is flat across all overload bands (no regime change within the measured range)
P4_capacity.prediction_is_about_pattern_not_level: the closure LEVEL at a single constant reference is near-tautological and is NOT predicted; only the pattern is

swap_rate_observation.quantity: swap rate (fraction of selected-set changes between consecutive front members) vs overload
swap_rate_observation.status: OBSERVATIONAL, not a prediction -- the ticket registers it as an optional observation item, so it carries no refutation condition and must be reported as exploratory if at all

stratum_rule_determinacy.problem: the reviewer found the stratum rule under-specified: 'all-STR degenerate-anchor family OR median distinct_fq < 2' has no defined analogue of M1NC's all-STR property for the R families, and a per-seed median can flip between strata on a reseed
stratum_rule_determinacy.fix: the rule is evaluated ONCE, on the registered base seed and the base budget, per family -- not per seed and not averaged over the ladder. A family's stratum is a property of that family's registered base run
stratum_rule_determinacy.all_STR_clause_for_R_families: the R families are defined by demand tier, not by mode, so the all-STR clause is replaced by its measurable content: a family is structural-null if the front's f_q RANGE (max f_q - min f_q over front records) is zero to floating-point for every unit. Measured on v1: M1NC and M3NC have f_q range 1.110e-16 across all their units while the three non-degenerate families range 2.4-3.6. This is the condition that makes dq_all's sd exactly zero, and it is stated on the RANGE rather than on distinct_fq because distinct_fq rounds at 1e-6 and would misclassify a family whose spread is small but non-zero
stratum_rule_determinacy.median_clause: median distinct_fq < 2 is evaluated at the registered base seed and base budget only
stratum_rule_determinacy.redundancy_note: on the v1 evidence the range clause is subsumed by the median clause (all three degenerate families already have median distinct_fq < 2). It is retained because the two clauses fail differently: a family with genuinely rich fronts but zero per-unit range would be caught only by the range clause

R_fam = 3.9998 dB (base seed 100), max over the 10 seeds 3.9998 dB, per-seed minimum 3.9968 dB -- all below 6.0 dB, so the verdict does not depend on which seed is read -- and it is budget- and solver-independent by construction. strata_disposition.R2F: DESCRIPTIVELY ALIVE. R_fam = 9.7524 dB at the registered base seed 200, max over the 10 seeds 12.1261 dB, per-seed minimum 8.2652 dB -- three different aggregates, none of which is the others. The verdict is a STRUCTURAL statement on the model-level bound, not a claim about the budget-converged readout (see convergence_verdicts)

It does not mean promotion fires, it does not mean the readout has converged, and it does not license any physical claim. convergence_verdicts.R2F: SEARCH-ARTIFACT, a falsified reading. At the base budget the apparent front collapse (median front 19.5, one unit at a single point) does not survive the budget ladder: at 160/240 the median front is 84.5 and distinct-fq median 64.5 (4.4x the base median). The base-budget reading was a search artifact, and any narrative built on it is VOID
convergence_verdicts.R3H: SEARCH-ARTIFACT, and this is the decisive one: the collapse narrative is already falsified. At the base budget 6 of 10 units have a single-point front and the median front is 1; at 160/240 the median front is 140 and distinct-fq median 99 (99x the base median). The observed front collapse was a budget artifact of running pop40 x gen60 against 2N=200 decision variables, NOT a property of the scenario. The physical-collapse narrative is withdrawn and must never be asserted in either direction
convergence_verdicts.NOT_PLATEAUED: both families are still rising monotonically at the top budget (R3H distinct-fq 26 -> 99 between 80/120 and 160/240), so per the preregistered clause the plateau rule is NOT satisfied. 'The converged true front' remains unknown and ANY front-richness bound claim is forbidden in BOTH directions at this budget
convergence_verdicts.promotion_final: no_promotion over all 90 units (3 families x 3 budgets x 10 seeds), maximum spread 3.9722 dB (3.97 at two decimals) against the frozen 6.0 dB threshold. The no-promotion verdict is therefore ROBUST TO BUDGET across a 16x budget range and may be cited as a structural reading with its budget evidence attached. This supersedes the 'terminal verdict pending' state recorded at N2 in RUN_LINEAGE.md
convergence_verdicts.budget_not_escalated: the budget allowance above 160/240 is NOT raised. Decided by the user on 2026-10-05: chasing budget buys frontier richness, not a promotion verdict (the promotion verdict is already budget-robust, and the M family is equally promotion-dead at 160/240). Trigger to revisit: a reviewer explicitly asks for convergence evidence. Per the frozen forbidden list, no front-collapse or phase-transition statement is licensed in any branch
convergence_verdicts.tier_usage: the base (40/60) readings are retained as an under-converged baseline ONLY. Any frontier-richness or quality reading must be taken from the 160/240 artifacts and must carry the NOT-PLATEAUED caveat

capacity_status.detail: capacity_artifacts.serial_bound_derivation above registers the SYNTHETIC M-family serial bounds and states that v2 recomputes them on the R families and registers the recomputed values in an amendment BEFORE the run. That recomputation has NOT happened for v3. No v3 capacity number exists
capacity_status.consequence: the rule in capacity_artifacts.rule still binds: until the v3 recomputation lands, NO capacity NUMBER may appear in the paper. The prediction P4_capacity is NOT-YET-TESTED, not refuted. The closure narrative (deviation pattern vs the overload axis) is deferred with it
capacity_status.close_condition: recompute the serial bound and the closure pattern on the v3 real-window manifests, then register the values in a further amendment. Not scheduled

r_family_effect_size.units: f_q units (m^-2, the delivered-quality aggregate) for the R family
r_family_effect_size.dimension_note: the numeral 6.0 INHERITS the frozen 6.0 dB promotion threshold as a magnitude; it is NOT dimensionally equivalent to it (dB vs m^-2). The transfer is a numerical inheritance, registered as such, and must be written that way
r_family_effect_size.why_registered: audit4 B2: the value lived only in a handoff note and an issue file, and was registered AFTER the target was fixed. Registering it here, with its timestamp and its non-equivalence stated, is the honest form -- the writing must say 'registered after calibration, value inherited from the frozen threshold', not 'pre-registered'

power_design.estimand: dq_all (tests.primary_comparison.estimand) at the 160/240 tier, n = 10 seeds per family
power_design.measured_sd_note: sd is measured on dq_all, not on distinct_fq. Measured distinct-fq sd at the same tier is 11.45 / 22.97 and does NOT reproduce the registered MDE figures -- the two quantities are not interchangeable and only the dq_all reading matches the calibration record
power_design.seed_anchor_note: R3H at 54 seeds is a COST ANCHOR, not a plan: the budget decision of 2026-10-05 means it is not executed. The consequence for the writing is mandatory and asymmetric -- R2F may claim 92% power at the registered delta; R3H must disclose 29% and report its result as NOT reaching significance at this n

r_family_effect_size.what_it_does_not_constrain: ALIVE and DEAD are structural verdicts on R_fam and are NOT bound by this registered value. The delta governs the power of the quality-headroom test only. A family can be structurally ALIVE and still fail to reject at n=10
r_family_effect_size.reproduction: experiments/v3_results/_power_curve_rq_effect_size.py (the calibration-time curve); the machine anchor is scripts/verify_v3_verdicts.py, which recomputes sd, MDE and power from the promoted artifacts and pins delta, MDE and power

machine_anchor.covers: R_fam base/max/per-seed-min per family, the promotion 90-unit no_promotion verdict and its maximum spread, the R3H front and distinct-fq medians at the base and top budgets, the R1C anchor saturation and its base-budget front range, and delta / sd / MDE / power / seed count
machine_anchor.why: audit4 B8: claim_trace.json carries no experimental numbers, so every ALIVE/DEAD/no_promotion/MDE reading was recomputable but had no drift gate. Expectations are hardcoded in the script and never read out of the artifacts under test

writing_obligations_that_travel_with_thi: NOT-PLATEAUED caveat on any frontier-richness statement (160/240 has not plateaued; both directions are forbidden)
R3H power disclosure: 29% at n=10, 54 seeds would be needed for 80%, not executed
the v2 real-window numbers are permanently uncitable; the real-window readings come from experiments/v3_results only
the caliber tag travels: R-family f_q is NOT normalised (value range roughly 31-111 because the per-window R0 geometry expands it) and must never be mixed with the M family's [0,1]
'structurally dead' is a MODEL-level statement (P8WH-class knife-edge disclosure) and is never stated as physics
the 23.93 h repeat period is the two-body simulated value, not the J2 physical orbit's 14.75 orbits
